items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: The name 'Barry' appears only in the interviewer's turn: '[INTERVIEWER] Okay, it's going on the fourth reel now, Barry.' The interviewee does not mention Barry in their response or elsewhere in the provided text.

ctx.x: So why don't I run this off and put on a new one before we get into anything else? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Okay, it's going on the fourth reel now, Barry.

Dick, around 1954 I remember. Basin Street Six had really split up. I think Gerard formed his own band, but Pete and Joe Rodas, Bonnie Franks, they kept that name, Basin Street Six. And they were playing I think where Soul City is today, on Jefferson Highway, Airline Highway. And their regular band was Connie Jones was playing trumpet instead of George, and they had Johnny Edwards on drums instead of Charlie Duke. Outside of that the band was the same. But this kid Connie Jones had to go to National Guard, and…
